text:
frank: Quick note  I'm putting up a tiny docs PR to add a migration appendix for ScalePolicy v2. Focus: jq/sed conversion tips, canonical JSON example, CLI dry-run, and a short ops checklist. PR will be small.

maya: Love it. Can you include a one-liner that bulk-converts tenant_label -> tenant_selector using jq? Ops asked for that yesterday.

frank: Yep, planning to add this jq line in the appendix:```bash
cat old_policies.json | jq '.items |= map(.scalePolicy.tenant_selector = { matchLabels: { service: .scalePolicy.tenant_label } } | del(.scalePolicy.tenant_label))' > new_policies.json
```

tara: Add a sed variant for people who keep configs as simple YAML blobs. Also include the redwoodctl dry-run example so customers can validate.

frank: Good call. Adding sed example and the dry-run:```bash
redwoodctl scale apply --selector 'service=ingest' --min 1 --max 12 --cooldown 120 --isolation hardened --dry-run
```

maya: Can you also add a tiny Go snippet for the SDK users and a note about handling 409 conflict during rollouts?

frank: Short Go sample I plan to include:```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
pol := redwood.ScalePolicy{Min:1, Max:12, Cooldown:120}
if err := client.ApplyScalePolicy(ctx, "tenant-ingest", pol); err != nil {
  if errors.Is(err, redwood.ErrConflict) {
    // rollout conflict - retry with backoff
  }
}
```

tara: Also put a tiny ops checklist: 1) verify pool tags match selector 2) run redwoodctl pool list --filter service=ingest 3) assign pool if missing

frank: Will add. One open question: default cooldown 60 vs 120? Perf suggested 120 for noisy workloads. Thinking default=120 and a small tuning table.

maya: 120 as default is fine, add table: chat=60, http/webhook=120, batch=300 and link to perfbench.

ops-bot: Draft PR created by frank: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/951 labels: docs,dedicated,scalepolicy

frank: Tagging @maya and @tara as reviewers. I'll also open a backport PR for the oncall handbook after merge.

maya: Happy to review migration appendix tonight.

tara: I'll check the ops checklist and sed example.

ops-bot: frank merged pull request 951 into main  closed by frank

maya: Thanks! Please backport the troubleshooting note about multi-label selectors falling back to best-effort preemption. That helped a customer earlier.

frank: Noted, opening backport now.

tara: Nice, clean and practical change.
